sermon.title: It's Time to Act Like Men
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer uses Ezra as an example for the last-day church. God stirred Cyrus, raised leaders and people, restored the robbed vessels and united them as one man. Zerubbabel refused builders who feared the Lord but served other gods. Despite legal opposition the house was finished through the prophets. Ezra fasted for adults, children and livelihood, and Revelation 21 shows the bride descending.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Revelation 21:9 spoken as “Revelations 20 19”; “Paul says” for 1 Peter 3:15; Ezra 2:64 number garbled; Book of Mormon horses claim; 1960s outpouring on Catholics and Lutherans; women angels at a Florida revival. Sensitive content kept as spoken: Joseph Smith/Brigham Young marrying other men’s wives (a private name garbled and marked [unclear]); Romney and fundamentalists; Muhammad marrying another man’s wife and a child; atheists called fools; same-sex marriage, abortion, marijuana; homosexuals and atheists removing Bible and prayer from schools; new president gave Christian leaders “every concession”; Bush Sr. rejected the Christian right.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls filled with the seven last plagues came to me and talked with me, saying, “Come, I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.” And he carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,

But I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple. The city had no need of the sun or of the moon to shine in it, for the glory of God illuminated it. The Lamb is its light. And the nations of those who are saved shall walk in its light, and the kings of the earth bring their glory and honor into it.
Whoever offers praise glorifies Me; And to him who orders his conduct aright I will show the salvation of God.”
All the kings of the earth shall praise You, O LORD, When they hear the words of Your mouth.

faqs.question: Were Israel’s events written for us?
faqs.answer: Yes, as examples for those at the ends of the ages.

faqs.question: Was the peace offering required?
faqs.answer: No, it was a freewill thank offering.

faqs.question: Is financial blessing a sign of God’s approval?
faqs.answer: He says never mistake it for that.

faqs.question: Does God give up on those Satan tricked back?
Why does Jesus want his people one?
faqs.answer: So the world may believe that the Father sent him.

faqs.question: Should we serve God out of fear of hell?
faqs.answer: He says serve God because he is God.

faqs.question: Are there women angels?
faqs.answer: He says no; angels are spirit beings.

faqs.question: What three things did Ezra fast for?
faqs.answer: A right way for adults, children and their substance.

faqs.question: What glory do kings bring into the city?
